review_description: Worst costumer service/after sales. I have decided to go with saj inventer based on the recommendation of the solar company.. 4 weeks after installation, it is not producing the way it should. Its a 10.56kw tier 1 panels and yet it only produce less than 5kw the whole day, on a good sunny day. Saj does not want to honor any warranty. Will never purchase anything from them ever again. Steer away if possible.
Quick installation and very smooth process of sale. Sales man was very polite and honest.
I’m very happy with all the process. They were very punctual and professional. Quoting process and prices were all good. They helped organise the grid connection after the installation.
Really impressive way of working ,quick and efficient, quality work and friendly service, highly recommend
Sales and quoting were well explained and wasn’t overly pushy, installation was quick and punctual and overall customer service was second to none. Great experience
